about: Distribution transformer makers used in Pakistan and the technical data they publish. Only Pakistani sources. A maker without published data uses the IEC 60076-5 minimum impedance until its datasheet / nameplate value is added. The online copy of this file (GitHub powerpath-live-sources) is read by the 'Update data' button.

list_source.document: Punjab Health PMU, RFP Letter No. PSH/PMU/PROC/007/2021 (29 April 2021): invitation to PEPCO / WAPDA / DISCO's Pre-qualified & Registered manufacturers

fault_level_rule.text: NEPRA Distribution Code 2005, DDC 3.1(c): equipment shall suit the design short-circuit rating of the Licensee (DISCO) distribution system; details of the system are provided by the Licensee. No fixed 11 kV value is published: ask your DISCO for the fault level at your connection point.
